MOD = 1000000007

def main():
    p, k = map(int, input().split())
    num = 1
    if k <= 1:
        limit = p - 1 + k
        num = pow(p, limit, MOD)
    else:
        used = [False] * p
        for i in range(1, p):
            if used[i]:
                continue
            num = (num * p) % MOD
            cur = i
            used[cur] = True
            cur = (cur * k) % p
            while cur != i:
                used[cur] = True
                cur = (cur * k) % p
    print(num)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
